prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Generate 5 ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question, each with a short title and a description of one or two sentences. Sample the ideas from the full distribution of possible responses, and give each idea its estimated probability of being generated (a number between 0 and 1).

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&Tag of AP-1 occupancy after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Profile chromatin accessibility and AP-1 (FOS/JUN) binding at timepoints during and long after a transient stimulus (e.g., inflammation, injury, stress) to identify sites that stay open after AP-1 levels return to baseline. Persistence of accessibility at AP-1 motif sites indicates memory.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation after priming (degron/dominant-negative)
ideas.description: Use inducible degradation (dTAG/AID) or dominant-negative A-FOS at different times: during priming versus after the stimulus has ended. If the memory response persists when AP-1 is removed after priming, AP-1 is only an initiator. If it is lost, AP-1 is needed to maintain memory.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation assays measuring faster or stronger transcriptional response
ideas.description: Prime cells, rest them for days to weeks, then restimulate and measure nascent transcription (PRO-seq/RNA-seq) and AP-1 recruitment kinetics versus naive cells. Test whether the enhanced response depends on AP-1-bound primed enhancers by CRISPR perturbation of the motifs.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome tracking of AP-1 activity and heritability through divisions
ideas.description: Combine single-cell RNA and ATAC, or live reporters of AP-1 activity, with lineage tracing to see whether the primed state is inherited by daughter cells. Quantify the persistence of the state, its bimodality, and its dependence on cell division.

ideas.title: Histone modification and chromatin remodeler co-profiling at AP-1 sites
ideas.description: Measure H3K27ac, H3K4me1, and BAF/SWI-SNF occupancy at AP-1 sites, and test whether inhibiting the remodeler or the modifying enzyme erases the memory. This tests whether AP-1 stores memory through epigenetic marks rather than its own continued presence.
